item.title: From 504 Timeout to 35ms: Autonomous Remediation of Silent Checkout Failures
item.description: A demonstration of fully autonomous code remediation: VALIS detected a critical silent checkout failure pattern, generated an async Kafka fix, deployed via GitOps, and validated a 4,700x latency improvement—all without human intervention.
